neighbours.label: ' say' in a rueful aside of the form 'wish I / we could say …' (one strong trigger found on a broad pole)
fire: The garden recovered nicely after the frost (wish we could say the same about the greenhouse).
Our flight left on time; I only wish I could say the same of the luggage.
I wish I could say that the meeting was productive, but it dragged on for hours.
The puppy settled in quickly, though we wish we could say as much for the cat.
The bridge held firm in the flood (wish they could say the same of the road).
I wish we could say the renovation is finished, but the kitchen still has no floor.
The first act was brilliant; I wish I could say the second lived up to it.
She aced the written exam, and she wishes she could say the same for the driving test.
quiet: The garden recovered nicely after the frost and the greenhouse was repaired.
Our flight left on time, and people say the same of the return leg.
I can say that the meeting was productive and finished within the hour.
The puppy settled in quickly, and the cat soon got used to it.
The bridge held firm in the flood and the road stayed open.
The builders say the renovation is finished and the kitchen has a new floor.
The first act was brilliant and the second lived up to it.
She aced the written exam and passed the driving test too.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.7% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) with no single token: commas, ' on', ' are', ' say' in asides and corrections. Probes: 'wish I could say the same' 1.14, 'I wish I could say that' 0.45, 'emphasis on <repeated word>' 0.32-0.33; 'can't say the same' 0.01, 'the same cannot be said' 0.02. The label covers one trigger, surely not the whole pole.
